method_note: preflight.py FIXTURE_METHODS accepts only synthetic|masked_export; the ticket's `flyway_seed` is kept in seed_method. Rows come from the repo's Flyway seed V1.0.20210427174721__temp_data.sql (synthetic demo data); no production data, nothing to mask.
row_count_method: SELECT COUNT(*) per table as fixture_ro with SET SESSION TRANSACTION READ ONLY and SET time_zone='+00:00'
known_limits: banking_core_transaction has 0 rows: the Flyway seed never inserts transactions, so fan-out (account -> transactions) cannot be measured on this fixture; data_profile fanout for that edge will read 0 and must be treated as unmeasured, not as 1:0.
mysql:8 currently resolves to MySQL 8.4.11 (digest in server.image_digest), not an 8.0.x build; consistent with the app's own docker-compose/mysql/Dockerfile (FROM mysql:8.4.0).

server.time_zone_pin: SET PERSIST time_zone='+00:00' run once as root on the fixture (persisted in the mysql-data volume); the recon harness also runs SET time_zone='+00:00' per session

dsn.env_file: $HOME/.mmp-rt/b1-mysql.env (chmod 600, outside the repo; `source` it per shell). Root/RO passwords live in $HOME/.mmp-rt/b1-mysql.fixture-admin.env. Any copy inside the repo must match the .gitignore pattern .migration/**/*.env

steps: docker pull mysql:8   # compose uses pull_policy: never

mkdir -p $HOME/.mmp-rt && printf 'MYSQL_FIXTURE_PWD=%s\nMYSQL_FIXTURE_RO_PWD=%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 12)" "$(openssl rand -hex 12)" > $HOME/.mmp-rt/b1-mysql.fixture-admin.env && chmod 600 $HOME/.mmp-rt/b1-mysql.fixture-admin.env && source $HOME/.mmp-rt/b1-mysql.fixture-admin.env

cd $HOME/repos/mongo-migration-plugin && MYSQL_FIXTURE_PWD=$MYSQL_FIXTURE_PWD MYSQL_FIXTURE_DB=banking_core_service MYSQL_DDL_DIR=$HOME/repos/ts-java-spring-boot-internet-banking/core-banking-service/src/main/resources/db/migration docker compose -f skills/schema-modeling/docker-compose.local.yml --profile mysql up -d mysql
docker compose -f skills/schema-modeling/docker-compose.local.yml --profile mysql ps   # wait for (healthy); on failure: docker compose ... logs --no-log-prefix mysql | grep '^== '
MYSQL_PWD=$MYSQL_FIXTURE_PWD mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot banking_core_service -e "SELECT * FROM mmp_fixture_meta"   # scripts_failed must be 0

MYSQL_PWD=$MYSQL_FIXTURE_PWD mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'fixture_ro'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '$MYSQL_FIXTURE_RO_PWD'; GRANT SELECT, SHOW VIEW ON banking_core_service.* TO 'fixture_ro'@'%'; SET PERSIST time_zone='+00:00';"
re-measure: SELECT COUNT(*) on the 4 tables as fixture_ro must equal row_counts in this manifest (gate g-fixture-ready)
rebuild.teardown: cd $HOME/repos/mongo-migration-plugin && docker compose -f skills/schema-modeling/docker-compose.local.yml --profile mysql down -v   # -v drops the mysql-data volume so the init hook runs again

g-fixture-ready.row_counts_measured_as: fixture_ro, SELECT COUNT(*), 2 independent measurements (mysql CLI as root, PyMySQL as fixture_ro) agree
